gloss.intro: The words developers (an the AI teams) uise, in plain language.
gloss.switch.help: Dottit words get a plain explanation whan ye hover them.
gloss.backlog.text: Ideas an wark no plannit in yet. Nocht there gets warked on till it muives tae To do.
gloss.sprint.text: A short stretch o wark (aften a week or twa) wi an agreed set o cairds tae feenish.
gloss.standup.text: A quick check-in: whit ilka team member did, whit they dae next, an whit's stoppin them.
gloss.bug.text: Somethin that disnae wark the wey it should.
gloss.test.text: Tryin a feenished piece o wark tae check it dis whit wis askit, afore ye accept it.
gloss.commit.text: A saved snapshot o the code, wi a short note o whit chynged. Ye can aye gang back tae ane.
gloss.push.text: Sendin saved snapshots (commits) frae this computer up tae GitHub, sae they're backit up an shared.
gloss.branch.text: A separate line o wark in the code, sae chynges can be made wioot touchin the main version.
gloss.merge.text: Jinin a branch's chynges back intae the main version.
gloss.repo.text: The project's folder o code an its full history o commits, usually aye kept on GitHub.
gloss.refactor.text: Tidyin the code wioot chyngin whit it dis: smaller files, clearer names, less repetition.
gloss.deploy.text: Pittin a new version live, for example ontae a server whaur fowk uise it.
gloss.kanban.text: A board wi columns (To do, In progress, Done) whaur cairds muive left tae richt as wark happens.
gloss.wip.text: Wark in progress: the maist cairds a column should haud, sae the team feenishes things afore stertin mair.
gloss.pr.text: Askin for a branch's chynges tae be checked an merged intae the main version.
gloss.hook.text: A wee command that rins by itsel at a set moment, e.g. whan an AI session sterts, sae the team hears yer comments.
gloss.token.text: The unit AI usage is coontit in: roughly a few letters o text read or written. Fewer tokens, mair o yer plan left.
gloss.agent.text: An AI that warks on its ain on a task: reads the code, maks chynges, rins checks, an reports back.
